scoring_justification: Recompute optimum thicknesses from the CSV, compare to paper-reported value 2.5 cm with monotonic tolerance, and check energy independence (difference ≤0.3 cm).

hidden_assets.purpose: gold optimum thickness 2.5 cm for 2 and 14 MeV, and tolerance constants
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig. 6 and text: optimum lead thickness constant 2.5 cm for 2–14 MeV neutrons
hidden_assets.generation_method: directly from paper's reported numeric value

schema.description: Optimum lead thickness for each neutron energy.

outputs.description: The optimum lead thickness determined from Monte Carlo simulations for 2 MeV and 14 MeV neutrons. Each row gives the energy and the thickness that maximized detection efficiency.
